term: General-Purpose AI Model With Systemic Risk
label: general-purpose AI model with systemic risk
definition: A general-purpose AI model classified as such if it possesses high impact capabilities evaluated via technical tools, or has equivalent capabilities based on Commission decision or scientific panel alert.
source_quote: A general-purpose AI model shall be classified as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk if it meets any of the following conditions

label: high impact capabilities
definition: The specific capability threshold used to classify a general-purpose AI model as having systemic risk, evaluated using appropriate technical tools and methodologies.
source_quote: it has high impact capabilities evaluated on the basis of appropriate technical tools and methodologies

label: high impact capabilities (presumed)
definition: A presumption that a general-purpose AI model has high impact capabilities when its training computation exceeds 10^25 floating point operations.
source_quote: A general-purpose AI model shall be presumed to have high impact capabilities pursuant to paragraph 1, point (a), when the cumulative amount of computation used for its training measured in floating point operations is greater than 1025
